  project_id: ""
  report_title: "Short Vegetation + Environment"
  group_by: "layer"
  order_by: "species"
  presence_min: 0
  cover_min: 0
  value_limit: 0
  avg_type: "mean"
  show_common: "none"
  apply_lumping: false
  constancy_format: false
  display_value: "standard"
  colour_greater: 5
  gray_greater: 65
  apply_theme: true
  project_root: ""

  parquet_dir: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(duckdb)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

options(knitr.table.format = "html")
has_kableExtra <- requireNamespace("kableExtra", quietly = TRUE)
if (has_kableExtra) {
  kbl <- kableExtra::kbl
  kable_styling <- kableExtra::kable_styling
  cell_spec <- kableExtra::cell_spec
} else {
  kbl <- function(x, ...) knitr::kable(x, ...)
  kable_styling <- function(x, ...) x
  cell_spec <- function(x, ...) x
}
project_root <- params$project_root
db_root <- ""
db_path <- params$db_path
if (!is.null(db_path) && nzchar(trimws(db_path))) {
  db_candidate <- tryCatch(normalizePath(db_path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE), error = function(e) "")
  if (nzchar(db_candidate)) {
    db_root <- dirname(dirname(db_candidate))
  }
}
root_candidates <- c(
  if (!is.null(project_root)) project_root else "",
  db_root,
  Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR", unset = ""),
  getwd(),
  file.path(getwd(), ".."),
  file.path(getwd(), "../..")
)
root_candidates <- unique(root_candidates[nzchar(root_candidates)])
root_dir <- NA_character_
for (candidate in root_candidates) {
  candidate <- normalizePath(candidate, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  if (file.exists(file.path(candidate, "R", "logic_lumping.R"))) {
    root_dir <- candidate
    break
  }
}
if (is.na(root_dir)) stop("Unable to locate project root for report helpers.")
source(file.path(root_dir, "R", "logic_lumping.R"))
source(file.path(root_dir, "R", "logic_reports_veg.R"))
parquet_dir <- params$parquet_dir
if (!is.null(parquet_dir) && nzchar(trimws(parquet_dir))) {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = ":memory:")
  dbExecute(con, "CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS lists")
  tbls <- c("vw_USysAllVeg", "Sample_Env", "Sample_SU", "Sample_Lump", "LayerCode")
  for (tbl in tbls) {
    file_name <- paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", tbl), ".parquet")
    file_path <- file.path(parquet_dir, file_name)
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      dbExecute(
        con,
        sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('%s')", tbl, gsub("'", "''", file_path))
      )
    }
  }
  list_file <- file.path(parquet_dir, "lists_USysAllSpecs.parquet")
  if (file.exists(list_file)) {
    dbExecute(
      con,
      sprintf("CREATE TABLE VLists.USysAllSpecs AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('%s')", gsub("'", "''", list_file))
    )
  }
} else {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), params$db_path, read_only = TRUE)
  dbExecute(con, "ATTACH '../data/vpro_lists.duckdb' AS lists")
}
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
plot_number <- if (is.null(params$plot_number)) "" else as.character(params$plot_number)
plot_numbers <- if (is.null(params$plot_numbers)) "" else as.character(params$plot_numbers)
plots <- parse_plot_numbers(plot_number, plot_numbers)
veg <- load_veg_report_data(
  con,
  plot_numbers = plots,
  site_unit = trimws(params$site_unit),
  project_id = trimws(params$project_id),
  apply_lumping = isTRUE(params$apply_lumping)
)

summary <- summarize_veg_report(
  veg,
  group_by = if (isTRUE(params$constancy_format)) "lifeform" else params$group_by,
  order_by = params$order_by,
  presence_min = params$presence_min,
  cover_min = params$cover_min,
  value_limit = params$value_limit,
  avg_type = params$avg_type,
  show_common = params$show_common,
  display_value = params$display_value
)

plot_list <- unique(veg$plotnumber)
if (length(plot_list) == 0) plot_list <- plots
if (length(plot_list) > 0) {
  plot_sql <- paste(DBI::dbQuoteString(con, plot_list), collapse = ", ")
  env <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, sprintf("SELECT * FROM Sample_Env WHERE PlotNumber IN (%s)", plot_sql))
} else {
  env <- data.frame()
}

normalize_env_cols <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  cols <- names(df)
  pick_col <- function(candidates) {
    idx <- which(tolower(cols) %in% tolower(candidates))
    if (length(idx) > 0) cols[[idx[1]]] else NA_character_
  }
  map <- list(
    plotnumber = c("plotnumber", "PlotNumber"),
    projectid = c("projectid", "ProjectID"),
    date = c("date", "Date"),
    sitesurveyor = c("sitesurveyor", "SiteSurveyor"),
    latitude = c("latitude", "Latitude"),
    longitude = c("longitude", "Longitude"),
    elevation = c("elevation", "Elevation"),
    aspect = c("aspect", "Aspect"),
    slopegradient = c("slopegradient", "SlopeGradient"),
    mesoslopeposition = c("mesoslopeposition", "MesoSlopePosition"),
    surfaceshape = c("surfaceshape", "SurfaceShape"),
    moistureregime = c("moistureregime", "MoistureRegime"),
    nutrientregime = c("nutrientregime", "NutrientRegime")
  )
  for (target in names(map)) {
    source <- pick_col(map[[target]])
    if (!is.na(source)) df[[target]] <- df[[source]]
  }
  df
}

env <- normalize_env_cols(env)

dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

## Environment

```{r env-table, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nrow(env) > 0) {
  desired <- c("plotnumber", "projectid", "date", "sitesurveyor", "latitude", "longitude", "elevation",
               "aspect", "slopegradient", "mesoslopeposition", "surfaceshape", "moistureregime",
               "nutrientregime")
  cols <- intersect(desired, names(env))
  env <- env[, cols, drop = FALSE]

  kbl(env, align = "l") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No environment data found.")
}
```

## Vegetation

```{r veg-table, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nrow(summary) > 0) {
  constancy_format <- isTRUE(params$constancy_format)
  display_mode <- if (!is.null(params$display_value) && nzchar(params$display_value)) {
    tolower(params$display_value)
  } else {
    "standard"
  }
  if (constancy_format) {
    view <- data.frame(
      Group = summary$group_label,
      Species = summary$species_label,
      Constancy = round(summary$presence_pct, 1),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else if (display_mode != "standard") {
    view <- data.frame(
      Group = summary$group_label,
      Species = summary$species_label,
      Display = summary$display_value,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    view <- data.frame(
      Group = summary$group_label,
      Species = summary$species_label,
      Presence = round(summary$presence_pct, 1),
      MeanCover = round(summary$mean_cover, 1),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  if (params$show_common != "none") {
    if (constancy_format) {
      view <- cbind(view[, c("Group", "Species")], Common = summary$common_label, view[, "Constancy", drop = FALSE])
    } else if (display_mode != "standard") {
      view <- cbind(view[, c("Group", "Species")], Common = summary$common_label, view[, "Display", drop = FALSE])
    } else {
      view <- cbind(view[, c("Group", "Species")], Common = summary$common_label, view[, c("Presence", "MeanCover")])
    }
  }

  apply_theme <- isTRUE(params$apply_theme)
  colour_greater <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(params$colour_greater))
  gray_greater <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(params$gray_greater))
  if (apply_theme && nrow(view) > 0) {
    style_numeric <- function(vec) {
      labels <- as.character(vec)
      vapply(seq_along(labels), function(i) {
        label <- labels[[i]]
        if (!nzchar(label)) return("")
        num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(label))
        if (is.na(num)) return(label)
        bg <- ""
        if (!is.na(gray_greater) && num >= gray_greater) {
          bg <- "#e6e6e6"
        } else if (!is.na(colour_greater) && num >= colour_greater) {
          bg <- "#f9e27d"
        }
        if (nzchar(bg)) cell_spec(label, background = bg) else label
      }, character(1))
    }
    num_cols <- names(view)[vapply(view, is.numeric, logical(1))]
    if (length(num_cols) == 0) {
      num_cols <- intersect(c("Constancy", "Display", "Presence", "MeanCover"), names(view))
    }
    for (col_name in num_cols) {
      view[[col_name]] <- style_numeric(view[[col_name]])
    }
  }

  kbl(view, align = "l", escape = !apply_theme) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No vegetation data found.")
}
```
